row.title: Deploys read every knowledge graph back; repo settings go through the admin App
row.body: datagraph --live runs after each deploy and daily. org-settings no longer goes red without ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN: the admin App sets delete_branch_on_merge and allow_auto_merge; the rest is gate org-admin-settings.
